shipping: Standard delivery takes 3 to 6 business days. Orders ship from the nearest warehouse and you get status updates at each step: placed, packed, shipped, out for delivery, delivered.
cancellation: You can cancel any order that has not been delivered. Before dispatch you get a full refund. After dispatch the delivery charge is kept and the rest is refunded to the original payment method.
refunds: Refunds go back to the original payment method and normally appear within 5 to 7 business days. Approved defect claims are refunded in full.
returns: If a product arrives damaged or defective, attach a clear photo in chat. A team member reviews it, usually within 24 hours.
contact: Support is available in this chat at any time. Human agents are available 9am to 9pm IST, Monday to Saturday.
complaints: Complaints are prioritised by type. Staff conduct, billing and defects are handled within 24 hours, late delivery and wrong items within 48 hours, and website issues within 5 days. Unresolved complaints escalate automatically.
